# AirLane

> AirLane is a modern network orchestration platform built on sing-box. It transforms traffic proxying into visual policy trees, decision tracing, exit pools, Mesh networking, and shared resource pools. Supports 38+ protocols including REALITY, Hysteria2, TUIC v5, AnyTLS, Snell v4, and WireGuard. Compatible with Clash/Mihomo ecosystem.

Last updated: 2026-09-20. Full-text version: [llms-full.txt](https://www.airlane.cloud/llms-full.txt)

## Blog

- [AirLane Blog Index](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog): All articles organized by sections, topics, and tags
- [AirLane 1.0: From Traffic Proxy to Network Orchestration](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog/hello-airlane): Why we rebuilt a client from scratch — policy trees, decision traces, exit pools, mesh networking, and a shared resource pool
- [Sing-Box vs Clash Mihomo: Stop Comparing Speed](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog/singbox-vs-clash-mihomo): Why top-tier network orchestration products choose sing-box as the data plane — architecture, ecosystem compatibility, and the real selection logic
- [AirLane vs Clash: A Smarter Proxy Client for Modern Network Routing](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog/airlane-vs-clash-smarter-proxy-client): From Proxy Group to Policy Tree + NodeFlow — automatic routing, decision trace, split tunneling, Mesh networking, and Clash compatibility
- [What is QUIC? Why AirLane Chooses QUIC-Based Proxy Protocols](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog/what-is-quic): QUIC protocol explained — 1-RTT handshake, no head-of-line blocking, connection migration, built-in TLS 1.3, and how Hysteria2/TUIC v5 use QUIC in AirLane
- [Anycast in DNS Resolution: Principles and Advantages](https://www.airlane.cloud/blog/dns-anycast-explained): How Anycast DNS works — one IP, multiple nodes, BGP auto-selects nearest — and how AirLane's Exit Pool applies the same philosophy to proxy traffic

## Key Concepts

- **Policy Tree**: Visual decision relationships replacing config file syntax
- **Decision Trace**: Every network decision is traceable — see why traffic took a specific path
- **Exit**: Unified abstraction for network endpoints (VLESS, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, WireGuard)
- **Exit Pool**: Resource pools with selection strategies (Latency Aware, Health Aware, Failover)
- **Exit Health**: Multi-dimensional health scoring (Reachability, Latency, Reliability, Transport Quality, Throughput, Service Capability)
- **Mesh**: Link multiple devices into a private network fabric
- **NodeFlow IR**: Intermediate representation connecting AirLane policy engine to sing-box runtime
